newsitem.title: UK: Bardon to acquire 14.99 pct in Bruntcliffe.
newsitem.headline: Bardon to acquire 14.99 pct in Bruntcliffe.

text.p: British quarrying and mining group Bardon Group Plc said on Thursday that it had acquired an option to pruchase 8.06 million shares in building materials firm Bruntcliffe Aggregates Plc.
In a statement, Bardon said the shares represented 14.99 percent in the present issued share capital of Bruntcliffe.
Bardon said the option also included one million stg of convertible unsecured loan stock 1999.
The loan stock is currently convertible into 2.86 million shares which would represent 5.05 percent of its enlarged share capital.
The purchase option, acquired for one pound, would be exercised for an aggregate consideration of 9.76 million ordinary 25p shares in Bardon.
The Bardon shares, with a current market value of 3.1 million stg represents 1.72 percent of Bardon's enlarged share capital.
The option would expire on January 3, 1997. Bardon also said it was in discussion with some vendors of Bruntcliffe, with a view to acquire further shares if the option was exercised.

Bardon's chief executive Peter Tom said the shareholding in Bruntcliffe was a strategic investment as it shared some of Bardon's markets namely Scotland, the Midlands and the mid-Atlantic states of the U.S.
Tom said Bardon had no intention to make a full bid for Bruntcliffe.
